DK92.2 is a medical diagnosis code representing unspecified gastrointestinal bleeding ("gastrointestinal blødning UNS"). In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality databases, it serves as a critical data point for tracking adverse events. Specifically, DK92.2 is utilized in the quality indicator measuring the incidence of severe bleeding ([[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]]) among patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation ([[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]]) [^src1] [^src3].

To comprehensively capture bleeding complications, the national registries employ a wide spectrum of diagnostic codes. DK92.2 is grouped with other gastrointestinal bleeding codes, such as [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] and [[dk92-1|DK92.1]], as well as codes for intracranial bleeding (ranging from [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (such as [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. 

The code's definition and application have remained consistent across successive annual reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut). It functions as a standardized technical reference for register-based analyses, ensuring that data collection and quality comparisons for cardiovascular disease treatments remain uniform across Danish regions [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].
